content.short: Monorail is a Monad swap aggregator combining AMMs, on-chain order books and RFQ liquidity.
content.description: Monorail routes trades on Monad across three liquidity models at once, pulling from AMM pools, on-chain order books and request-for-quote market makers under one execution path. Monad's documentation lists it among the chain's DEX aggregators. Combining order books with AMMs is more feasible on a chain with Monad's throughput, where posting and cancelling orders on-chain is cheap enough to be practical.
